content: DeepSeek API: errors 400 bad body, 401 auth, 402 insufficient balance, 422 invalid params, 429 rate limit (suggest switching provider), 500 server, 503 overloaded -> retry. Context caching automatic, prefix-based, usage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens/miss. Current models (Oct 2026 docs): deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro. Thinking mode on by default; with tools, reasoning_content must be passed back in all subsequent requests or API returns 400; disable via thinking:{type:'disabled'}.
